body.id: Penduduk Indonesia tidak tersebar merata: menurut Sensus Penduduk 2020, 56,1% tinggal di Pulau Jawa, yang luasnya hanya sekitar 7% wilayah negara.
body.en: Indonesia's people are unevenly spread: in the 2020 census, 56.1% lived on Java, which is only about 7% of the country's area.

body.id: Orang berpindah karena faktor pendorong (lahan sempit, kerja sulit) dan penarik (pekerjaan, sekolah, layanan): merantau, transmigrasi, urbanisasi.
body.en: People move because of push factors (little land, scarce work) and pull factors (jobs, schools, services): merantau, transmigration, urbanisation.

body.id: Kota yang tumbuh cepat menghadapi risiko baru. Di pesisir Jakarta, pengambilan air tanah berlebihan membuat tanah turun dan banjir rob makin sering.
body.en: Fast-growing cities face new risks. On Jakarta's coast, heavy groundwater pumping makes the ground sink and tidal floods more frequent.

body.id: Perjanjian sah jika ada kesepakatan, para pihak cakap hukum, objeknya jelas, dan sebabnya tidak melanggar hukum (Pasal 1320 KUH Perdata). Meterai bukan syarat sah.
body.en: An agreement is valid with consent, parties with legal capacity, a clear subject and a lawful purpose (Civil Code art. 1320). A duty stamp (meterai) is not a condition.

body.id: UU No. 8 Tahun 1999 memberi konsumen hak atas informasi yang benar, hak didengar keluhannya, dan hak atas ganti rugi. Sengketa bisa dibawa ke BPSK.
body.en: Law No. 8 of 1999 gives consumers the right to truthful information, to be heard and to compensation. Disputes can go to the BPSK consumer dispute board.

body.id: RT dan RW adalah lembaga kemasyarakatan, mitra pemerintah desa atau kelurahan. Pengurusnya warga setempat, bukan pegawai negeri.
body.en: The RT and RW are community bodies that partner the village or kelurahan government. They are run by local residents, not civil servants.

meaning.id: Pulau dengan penduduk terbanyak?
meaning.en: The island where most people live?

model_answer.id: Jawa: sekitar 7% wilayah, tetapi 56,1% penduduk (SP2020).
model_answer.en: Java: about 7% of the land, but 56.1% of the people (2020 census).

meaning.id: Berapa persen penduduk Indonesia tinggal di perkotaan pada 2020?
meaning.en: What share of Indonesians lived in urban areas in 2020?

model_answer.id: Sekitar 56,7% pada 2020 (BPS), dan diproyeksikan terus naik.
model_answer.en: About 56.7% in 2020 (BPS), and projected to keep rising.

meaning.id: Faktor pendorong atau penarik migrasi?
meaning.en: A push or a pull factor for migration?

text.id: Lowongan kerja dan upah lebih tinggi

model_answer.id: Pendorong: lahan sempit, bencana, gagal panen. Penarik: pekerjaan, upah, kampus, rumah sakit.
model_answer.en: Push: shrinking land, disasters, failed harvests. Pull: jobs, wages, universities, hospitals.

meaning.id: Istilah → artinya.
meaning.en: Term → meaning.

text.id: Program pemerintah memindahkan penduduk ke pulau lain
text.en: A government programme moving people to another island

text.id: Bertambahnya bagian penduduk yang tinggal di kota
text.en: A growing share of people living in cities

text.id: Pulang ke kampung halaman, misalnya saat hari raya
text.en: Going back to one's home town, for example for a holiday

text.id: Pergi dari kampung untuk bekerja atau belajar, sering dengan niat kembali
text.en: Leaving home to work or study, often meaning to return

model_answer.id: Merantau: pergi untuk bekerja atau belajar. Transmigrasi: program pindah antarpulau. Urbanisasi: penduduk kota bertambah. Mudik: pulang kampung.
model_answer.en: Merantau: leaving to work or study. Transmigrasi: a programme moving people between islands. Urbanisation: cities' share grows. Mudik: going home.

meaning.id: Asal tradisi merantau Minangkabau?
meaning.en: Home of the Minangkabau merantau tradition?

model_answer.id: Masyarakat Minangkabau di Sumatra Barat dikenal dengan tradisi merantau.
model_answer.en: The Minangkabau of West Sumatra are known for their merantau tradition.

meaning.id: Perpindahan penduduk antarpulau yang terencana baru dimulai setelah 1945.
meaning.en: Planned moves of people between islands only began after 1945.

model_answer.id: Perpindahan terencana dimulai 1905 sebagai "kolonisasi" ke Gedong Tataan, Lampung, lalu berlanjut sebagai transmigrasi.
model_answer.en: Planned moves began in 1905 as "colonisation" to Gedong Tataan, Lampung, and later continued as transmigrasi.

meaning.id: Penyebab utama tanah Jakarta Utara turun?
meaning.en: The main cause of sinking ground in North Jakarta?

model_answer.id: Air tanah terus disedot, lapisan tanah memadat, dan permukaannya turun.
model_answer.en: Groundwater keeps being pumped out, the soil compacts and the surface sinks.

meaning.id: Rantai sebab dan akibat.
meaning.en: Chain of cause and effect.

text.id: Banyak gedung dan rumah menyedot air tanah
text.en: Many buildings and homes pump groundwater

text.id: Air laut pasang lebih mudah masuk: banjir rob
text.en: High tides flow in more easily: tidal flooding

model_answer.id: Air tanah disedot, tanah memadat, permukaan turun, lalu rob lebih mudah masuk.
model_answer.en: Groundwater pumped, soil compacts, ground sinks, then tides flood in more easily.

meaning.id: Banyak kota tua tumbuh di tepi…
meaning.en: Many old towns grew up along…

model_answer.id: Sungai dulu jalan raya perdagangan, jadi banyak kota tua tumbuh di tepinya.
model_answer.en: Rivers were the old trade highways, so many old towns grew up on their banks.

meaning.id: Penduduk 270 juta, 56,7% di kota. Berapa juta orang tinggal di kota?
meaning.en: Population 270 million, 56.7% urban. How many million people live in cities?

model_answer.id: 56,7% × 270 juta ≈ 153 juta orang.
model_answer.en: 56.7% × 270 million ≈ 153 million people.

meaning.id: Kota dan sungainya.
meaning.en: Cities and their rivers.

model_answer.id: Palembang–Musi, Pontianak–Kapuas, Samarinda–Mahakam, Jakarta–Ciliwung.
model_answer.en: Palembang–Musi, Pontianak–Kapuas, Samarinda–Mahakam, Jakarta–Ciliwung.

model_answer.id: Gambar peta keluarga Anda: dari mana kakek-nenek berasal dan ke mana anggota keluarga merantau. Banyak keluarga Indonesia ternyata tersebar di beberapa pulau.
model_answer.en: Draw your family map: where your grandparents came from and where relatives moved. Many Indonesian families turn out to be spread over several islands.

meaning.id: Berapa bagian penduduk Indonesia yang tinggal di Jawa?
meaning.en: What share of Indonesians live on Java?

model_answer.id: Lebih dari separuh penduduk Indonesia tinggal di Jawa (56,1% pada SP2020).
model_answer.en: More than half of Indonesians live on Java (56.1% in the 2020 census).

meaning.id: Program pemerintah memindahkan penduduk antarpulau disebut…
meaning.en: A government programme moving people between islands is called…

model_answer.id: Transmigrasi adalah program pemerintah untuk memindahkan penduduk ke pulau lain.
model_answer.en: Transmigrasi is a government programme for moving people to other islands.

meaning.id: Banjir rob adalah banjir karena air laut pasang.
meaning.en: Rob is flooding caused by high tides.

model_answer.id: Rob adalah banjir dari air laut pasang, makin sering di pesisir yang tanahnya turun.
model_answer.en: Rob is flooding from high tides, more frequent where coastal ground is sinking.

items.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Minangkabau" (descent and inheritance through the female line; britannica.com); Peggy Reeves Sanday, Women at the Center: Life in a Modern Matriarchy (Cornell University Press, 2002).

model_answer.id: Masyarakat Minangkabau menganut sistem matrilineal: garis keturunan dan warisan, termasuk rumah gadang dan tanah pusaka kaum, diturunkan melalui garis ibu. Mereka sering disebut salah satu masyarakat matrilineal terbesar di dunia.
model_answer.en: The Minangkabau are matrilineal: descent and inheritance, including the clan's rumah gadang and ancestral land, pass down the mother's line. They are often called one of the largest matrilineal societies in the world.

meaning.id: Syarat sah perjanjian atau bukan?
meaning.en: A condition for a valid agreement, or not?

text.id: Para pihak cakap hukum, misalnya sudah dewasa
text.en: Both have legal capacity, e.g. are adults

text.id: Objeknya jelas dan tidak melanggar hukum
text.en: Its subject is clear and lawful

model_answer.id: Syaratnya: sepakat, cakap, objek tertentu, dan sebab yang tidak melanggar hukum. Meterai dan jenis kertas bukan syarat sah.
model_answer.en: The conditions: consent, capacity, a specific subject and a lawful purpose. Stamps and the kind of paper are not.

meaning.id: Perjanjian tanpa meterai tidak sah.
meaning.en: An agreement without a duty stamp is not valid.

model_answer.id: Mitos. Meterai adalah pajak atas dokumen; perjanjian tetap sah tanpanya. Jika dokumen dipakai sebagai bukti di pengadilan, meterai dapat dibubuhkan kemudian.
model_answer.en: Myth. The stamp is a tax on documents; the agreement is valid without it. If it is used as court evidence, the duty can be paid later.

meaning.id: Struk bertuliskan "Barang yang sudah dibeli tidak dapat dikembalikan." Menurut UU Perlindungan Konsumen, klausul ini…
meaning.en: A receipt says "Goods sold cannot be returned." Under the Consumer Protection Law, this clause is…

model_answer.id: Pasal 18 UU No. 8/1999 melarang klausula baku yang menolak pengembalian barang yang dibeli konsumen.
model_answer.en: Art. 18 of Law 8/1999 bans standard clauses that refuse the return of goods bought by consumers.

meaning.id: Masalah → tempat mengadu.
meaning.en: Problem → where to complain.

text.en: A dispute with a seller isn't resolved

text.id: Masalah dengan layanan bank atau pembiayaan
text.en: A problem with a bank or finance company

model_answer.id: Sengketa dengan penjual ke BPSK, keamanan pangan dan obat ke BPOM, layanan keuangan ke OJK.
model_answer.en: Disputes with a seller go to the BPSK, food and drug safety to BPOM, financial services to OJK.

meaning.id: Langkah aman menyewa rumah.
meaning.en: Safe steps for renting a house.

text.id: Tulis perjanjiannya dan tanda tangani berdua
text.en: Write it down and both sign

text.id: Sepakati harga, lama sewa, dan siapa memperbaiki apa
text.en: Agree the price, the term and who repairs what

text.id: Periksa kondisi rumah dan bukti kepemilikannya
text.en: Check the house and proof of ownership

model_answer.id: Periksa dulu, sepakati isinya, tulis dan tanda tangani, lalu bayar dan simpan kuitansi.
model_answer.en: Check first, agree the terms, write and sign, then pay and keep the receipt.

meaning.id: Warga ingin mengadakan kerja bakti di gang. Sebaiknya berkoordinasi dengan…
meaning.en: Residents want to hold a clean-up day in their lane. They should coordinate with…

model_answer.id: Kegiatan bersama di lingkungan dikoordinasikan dengan pengurus RT setempat.
model_answer.en: Shared activities in the neighbourhood are coordinated with the local RT officers.

meaning.id: RT dan RW adalah kantor pemerintah dengan pegawai negeri.
meaning.en: RT and RW are government offices staffed by civil servants.

model_answer.id: RT dan RW adalah lembaga kemasyarakatan, mitra pemerintah desa atau kelurahan; pengurusnya warga setempat.
model_answer.en: RT and RW are community bodies that partner the local government; their officers are local residents.

meaning.id: Ponsel baru rusak dalam masa garansi. Langkah pertama?
meaning.en: A new phone breaks within the warranty period. First step?

text.id: Hubungi penjual atau pusat servis dengan nota dan kartu garansi
text.en: Contact the seller or service centre with the receipt and warranty card

text.id: Langsung menulis ulasan marah di media sosial
text.en: Post an angry review straight away

model_answer.id: Bawa nota dan kartu garansi ke penjual atau pusat servis resmi. Jika buntu, adukan ke BPSK.
model_answer.en: Take the receipt and warranty card to the seller or official service centre. If that fails, go to the BPSK.

meaning.id: Hak konsumen menurut UU 8/1999 atau bukan?
meaning.en: A consumer right under Law 8/1999, or not?

text.id: Mendapat informasi yang benar tentang barang
Membayar di bawah harga yang tertera
Mendapat ganti rugi jika barang tidak sesuai
text.en: Compensation if goods are not as agreed

model_answer.id: Hak konsumen: informasi yang benar, didengar keluhannya, ganti rugi. Barang gratis dan diskon sepihak bukan hak.
model_answer.en: Consumer rights: truthful information, being heard, compensation. Free goods and self-made discounts are not rights.

meaning.id: Istilah dan artinya.
meaning.en: Terms and their meanings.

text.id: Uang jaminan yang kembali di akhir sewa
text.en: Security money returned at the end

text.id: Aturan yang disiapkan sepihak oleh penjual
text.en: Terms prepared in advance by the seller
Failing to do what was agreed

model_answer.id: Wanprestasi: ingkar janji. Kuitansi: bukti bayar. Deposit: uang jaminan. Klausula baku: aturan sepihak yang disiapkan penjual.
model_answer.en: Wanprestasi: breach. Kuitansi: receipt. Deposit: security money. Standard clause: terms set in advance by the seller.

meaning.id: Pengurus RT dan RW di desa dilarang merangkap anggota ____.
meaning.en: RT and RW officers in villages may not also be members of a ____.

model_answer.id: Larangan ini tercantum dalam Permendagri No. 18 Tahun 2018, Pasal 8 ayat (5).
model_answer.en: This ban is in Interior Ministry Regulation 18/2018, art. 8(5).

model_answer.id: Hari ini, foto atau simpan nota dan kartu garansi barang penting Anda dalam satu map. Bukti seperti itu memudahkan klaim garansi atau pengaduan.
model_answer.en: Today, photograph or file the receipts and warranty cards for your important purchases in one folder. Proof like that makes a warranty claim or complaint much easier.

meaning.id: Berapa syarat sah perjanjian dalam Pasal 1320 KUH Perdata?
meaning.en: How many validity conditions does art. 1320 of the Civil Code list?

model_answer.id: Empat: sepakat, cakap, hal tertentu, dan sebab yang tidak melanggar hukum.
model_answer.en: Four: consent, capacity, a specific subject and a lawful purpose.

meaning.id: Konsumen berhak didengar keluhannya.
meaning.en: Consumers have the right to have complaints heard.

model_answer.id: Hak untuk didengar pendapat dan keluhannya ada dalam Pasal 4 UU No. 8 Tahun 1999.
model_answer.en: The right to have opinions and complaints heard is in art. 4 of Law 8/1999.

meaning.id: Pengurus RT dan RW adalah warga setempat, bukan pegawai negeri.
meaning.en: RT and RW officers are local residents, not civil servants.

model_answer.id: Pengurus RT dan RW adalah warga setempat yang mengabdi bagi lingkungannya.
model_answer.en: RT and RW officers are local residents serving their neighbourhood.

meaning.id: Saya ada di kabupaten/kota dan menyelesaikan sengketa konsumen di luar pengadilan. Nama singkat saya mirip BPS dan BPJS. Siapa saya?
meaning.en: I sit in regencies and cities and settle consumer disputes out of court. My acronym looks like BPS and BPJS. Who am I?

model_answer.id: BPSK: Badan Penyelesaian Sengketa Konsumen.
model_answer.en: BPSK: the consumer dispute settlement board.
